education.title: Intelligent Student Assessment & Curriculum Engine
education.body: An AI-driven assessment platform that evaluates student performance in real time, identifies learning gaps, and generates personalized lesson plans. The system combines multi-tenant LLM orchestration with vector search across curriculum frameworks to map weak points to precise educational resources with low-latency delivery.
education.meta: Curriculum mapping, student analytics, adaptive lesson planning

realEstate.title: Automated Property Syndication & Broker Training Platform
realEstate.body: A B2B real estate utility that connects with local CRMs, cleans listing data, and syndicates properties to regional portals through optimized XML streaming. A conversational AI simulator trains new brokers on complex off-plan projects through scenario-based mock client calls and certification flows.
realEstate.tag: Real Estate Automation — CRM to Portal Deployment
realEstate.meta: XML feeds, listing normalization, AI broker enablement

healthcare.title: Patient Health Scoring & Propensity Modeling Engine
healthcare.body: A predictive scoring engine built into existing large-scale databases to analyze health signals, retention trends, and behavioral data. Custom machine learning models run across distributed pipelines to surface renewal propensity scores so teams can proactively support at-risk clients.
healthcare.meta: XGBoost models, health scoring, retention analytics

logistics.title: Omni-Channel WhatsApp Business Automation Dashboard
logistics.body: A unified customer operations dashboard that connects WhatsApp Business Cloud API conversations with core service workflows. Agents can use a live Status & Actions panel to renew subscriptions, trigger course updates, and execute business tasks through background workers without leaving the chat.
logistics.meta: Cloud API messaging, background jobs, agent actions

finance.title: Real-Time AI Credit Metering & Guardrails
finance.body: A high-throughput consumption infrastructure for enterprise platforms using AI at scale. The system tracks token usage, manages credit balances, applies budget limits, and routes complex LLM requests through caching and semantic optimization layers in real time.
finance.meta: Credit ledgers, semantic routing, streaming cost analytics
